what: block.zone_fill_segments(board, rect=None, nd=3, only_outside=False) - canonical set of ZONE fill polygon EDGES (per zone, per copper layer)
block.outside_geometry(board, rect, nd=3, include_zones=False) - now optionally adds the zone edges that lie OUTSIDE dR
delivered.default: include_zones=False => the JUDGE's C6 semantics are UNCHANGED by this commit (a criteria change is not the ENG's to make).

api_hazards_found_and_fixed: z.GetFilledPolysList(<id from ZoneSet.Seq()>) SEGFAULTS in this pcbnew build; a board.GetLayerID(<name>) id works.

pcbnew is not imported at block.py module scope (only inside functions) => zone_fill_segments needs its own local import, otherwise every zone raises NameError (silently swallowed by the per-zone guard) and the read returns 0.
the per-zone guard must be PER ZONE: a single blanket except made one bad zone void the whole read (it returned 0 while 10/18 zones do have fills).

decisive_measurement.read: zone_fill_segments(baseline) all-edges=36114, outside-edges=27181 (so the zone read is live).
decisive_measurement.comparison: legacy C6 (segments+vias): judged-board-vs-B0 diff=0 equal=True  ||  ZONE-AWARE C6: diff=943 equal=False
decisive_measurement.reading: the R1316 board PASSED the legacy C6 yet its OUTSIDE ZONE FILL differs from the baseline in 943 canonical edges => the false green is CONFIRMED and QUANTIFIED.
decisive_measurement.consequence_for_the_judge: flipping the JUDGE's C6 to zone-aware would FAIL this run (and by construction every run whose refill changes outside fills). So it is a JUDGED-CRITERIA decision: either (a) the chain stops touching outside fills, or (b) C6 is restated with a stated tolerance/scope, or (c) C6 stays legacy and the zone delta is reported as an adjacent row.
decisive_measurement.consequence_for_R_g: R-g (merging the P3V3 finger with the main plane) necessarily changes OUTSIDE fill => it can only be judged AFTER this contract question is settled. R-g therefore remains BLOCKED on the supervisory decision.
